speak.title: Role-play: a phone-free evening
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You think you both spend too much time on your phones. Suggest a phone-free evening once a week. Explain why, and offer ideas for things to do instead.

b.role: the housemate who loves their phone
b.text: You use your phone to talk to friends and to relax after work. You're not sure about the idea. Ask questions, say what worries you, and try to agree on a compromise.

phrases: I'd like to try something different.
I'm not sure that's a good idea.
I use my phone to keep in touch.
How about two hours, not the whole evening?
Okay, let's give it a go.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree on a plan, and what was the compromise?
